delivery.en: Parcels go through the local post or a courier; no official collection guide was found this pass
delivery.zh: 包裹走當地郵局或快遞；官方領件指南此次沒找到

readback.en: After 649, numbers go 3-3-4; 0 as zero; US dollars; 12-hour time; day before month
readback.zh: 649 區碼後照 3-3-4 唸，0 唸 zero；美元；12 時制；先日後月

fraud.en: A call spoofing the police or the FSC and asking for bank details or a transfer is a scam
fraud.zh: 偽裝警察或金融服務委員會、要銀行資料或轉帳的電話，都是詐騙

habits.en: Polite British-Caribbean English, with amounts in US dollars. Say mobile, not cell. Day first.
habits.zh: 客氣的英式加勒比英語，金額用美元。說 mobile 不說 cell。日期先日後月。

stall_local.en: I would only confirm a government or FSC matter officially, and the bank app just signed me out.
stall_local.zh: 政府或金管單位的事只想走正式管道確認，而且銀行 App 剛把我登出。

reason.zh: 美國稅局；本地警示寫的是假冒警察或金融服務委員會
美國轉帳工具，不是特克斯及凱科斯官方付款名稱
不是本地貨幣，這裡用美元
美式用語，當地較常說 mobile

talk_style_diff.en: Calm and formal. Never treat a caller claiming to be police or the FSC as a reason to move money. Use US dollars, not EC dollars or IRS talk.
talk_style_diff.zh: 沉穩、正式。自稱警察或金管會不能成為立刻轉錢的理由。金額用美元，不要說東加勒比元或 IRS。

uncertain: 郵政投遞細節此次沒找到官方指南。
FSC 公示是 PDF 警示，電話裡實際用詞可能比摘述更廣。
